title: Q-RULE-gap-qnfo-live: scan rendered live pages for QNFO data, not only page sources
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every lane pass
**Done check:** grep:foundation/rules.py::def p_qnfo_live
**Status:** closed

RULES-1 gap: the no-qnfo-on-pages rule scans page sources against a shrink-only baseline. Add a builtin probe `qnfo-live` that fetches the pages in site/probes.json from the deployed site and fails on QNFO data the sources do not carry, then register it as a runtime probe of the rule and delete this gap.

**Evidence:** `def p_qnfo_live` in foundation/rules.py is a builtin runtime probe of no-qnfo-on-pages; the gap entry is removed from doctrine/rules.json.
